notice.call_1122: If life is in danger, also call 1122.
trust.label: Trust
confidence.label: Confidence
service.down_hint: Reports can still be handled by hand.
error.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check the connection.
error.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
error.service_unavailable: The system is not available right now. If life is in danger, call 1122 now.
error.not_implemented: This part is not built yet ({task}).
report.intro: Tell us what happened. You do not need to sign in.
report.description_hint: What is happening, how many people are hurt, any danger (fire, gas, water). English, Urdu, Sindhi or Roman Urdu.
report.location_ok: Your location is added (accurate to about {meters} m).
report.location_denied: Location permission was refused. Please type the place or a landmark below.
report.location_unavailable: Your location could not be found. Please type the place or a landmark below.
report.location_unsupported: This browser cannot share a location. Please type the place or a landmark below.
report.address_hint: For example: near Clock Tower, Minara Road
report.location_none_note: No location yet. You can still send the report, but please describe the place.
report.phone_hint: So the dispatcher can call you back.
report.voice_note: Voice reports are not available yet. Please type your report.
report.privacy: Only what you enter here, and your location if you allow it, is sent.
report.err_not_saved: Your report was NOT saved. If life is in danger, call 1122 now. You can also try again.
report.err_not_sent: Your report was not sent: no connection. Check your internet and press Send again; it will not be sent twice.
report.err_too_many: Too many reports from this device. If life is in danger, call 1122 now.
report.err_other: Your report could not be sent ({code}). Please try again, or call 1122.
report.sent_text: Your report is saved and is in the dispatcher's queue. Keep this number.
report.sent_already: This report had already reached us; this is its reference number.
login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Dispatchers and administrators sign in with their own account.
login.err_driver: Drivers use the mobile app, not the dashboard. You have been signed out.
login.notice_session_ended: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.notice_idle: You were signed out after {minutes} minutes without activity.
idle.warning: No activity for a while: you will be signed out in {minutes} minutes.
page.not_allowed: Your role may not open this page.
queue.title: Incident queue
admin.title: Administration
admin.not_built: Administration is not built yet (task B1-A1-31).
reason.low_trust_urgent: Low trust — urgent, not held back
inc.not_found: There is no incident with this number.
inc.ai_failed: The AI could not read this report. Decide by hand (manual mode); nothing was lost.
inc.victims_check: Number of people hurt is not known: check before dispatching.
inc.no_recs: No vehicle could be recommended (none available, or the location is unknown).
dsp.heading: Send vehicles
dsp.manual: Manual dispatch — no AI recommendation. Choose from the vehicles below (nearest first).
dsp.backup: Vehicles are already on their way. You can send another vehicle (backup).
dsp.not_dispatchable: This report is {status}: no vehicle can be sent.
dsp.other_hint: Choose another vehicle yourself (nearest first, straight-line distance).
dsp.warn_low_trust: Low trust: the dispatcher decides; urgent reports are never held back.
dsp.call_driver: The driver is not alerted automatically yet — inform the driver by radio or phone.
dsp.err_locked: Not sent: {plates} is already on another job.
dsp.no_next_best: No other recommended vehicle is free. Choose one from "Other vehicles".
reason.vehicle_declined: A vehicle could not go — send another
trip.heading: Dispatched vehicles
trip.state.approved: Waiting for the driver to accept
trip.no_answer: No answer from the driver for {minutes} min — call the driver, or cancel and send another.
trip.hospital_changed: Hospital changed to {name} — inform the driver.
trip.cancel_text: The vehicle becomes free. If no other vehicle is going, the report goes back to "Needs check".
